title: Add an endpoint to fetch one invoice
body: The billing page needs a single invoice by id. Adds `getInvoice` next to `listInvoices` and a route for it.

expected.note: getInvoice ignores tenantId: any tenant can read another tenant's invoice by id

mustNotFlag.note: listInvoices filters by tenant and is unchanged
the route passes the caller's tenant; the bug is in the query
